title: Martin F. Helmke, PhD, PG
text:
I am a professor of hydrogeology in the Department of Earth & Space Sciences at West Chester University of Pennsylvania, and a practicing hydrogeologist with 30+ years of experience across research, teaching, and environmental projects.
I serve as President, Helmke Hydrogeologic, LLC and Principal Hydrogeologist (Tetra Tech). My work emphasizes fractured-rock hydrogeology, aquifer testing and parameter estimation, groundwater modeling, contaminant fate and transport (including PFAS), and applied geophysics/UAS methods.
Credentials: Pennsylvania Professional Geologist (PG #5117) • FAA Part 107 sUAS Pilot • HAZWOPER/Radiation Specialist
